name: Milis
source:
A new succubus who has arrived from the Demon Realm. Her personality is sadistic, self-centered, and arrogant, just as you’d expect from a demon!

She boasts a voluptuous figure that rivals even Leviola's. Determined to make the protagonist who possesses high-quality vital energy, her own, she ends up clashing with Leviola.

[From [url=http://www.gocha-mix.com/ol/ol03/index.html#jump_chara]official site[/url]]
